$comment: Every user-facing god power (CONTRACT §11.1, §16): category (radial ring group), icon key, radial ring (0 inner .. 2 outer), gesture (unistroke: spiral water, zigzag lightning, double-zigzag storm, circle shield, triangle fire, v heal, wave forest, square food, star meteor, heart fertility, caret teach, line wood, tilde calm, arrow fireball), command + default params, the UI schema of what can be tuned (types, ranges, units, what it targets), synonyms for the freeform parser, restraint cost (worship) and cooldown (ticks), and what witnesses make of it when the handler does not say. Generated palettes, radial menus and the parser read this file; every power must map to a registered command (tests/content.test.ts).

powers.name: Tornado

powers.name: Wildfire

powers.name: Plague

powers.name: Infestation

powers.name: Solar flare

powers.name: Impact winter
powers.desc: Dust hides the sun: a year of cold and failed harvests.

powers.name: Gravity slip

powers.name: Magnetic storm
powers.desc: The world's shield flickers: auroras at noon, birds lost, a rain of hard light.

powers.name: Second moon falling

powers.name: Acid rain

powers.name: Ice age
powers.desc: The cold comes down from the poles and does not leave: glaciers, frozen seas, short summers.

powers.name: Heat wave
powers.desc: Weeks of killing heat: the old and the weak fall, fields burn brown.

powers.name: Dust bowl
powers.desc: Overworked land dries and blows away; black blizzards bury the farms.

powers.name: Glass storm
powers.desc: Lightning walks the dunes all night; morning finds the sand fused into rivers of glass.

powers.name: Overgrowth

powers.name: Leviathan

powers.name: Forgetting fog
powers.desc: A grey mist settles and people walk out of it not knowing what they knew. Only what is written survives.

powers.name: Stampede
powers.desc: The herds panic: a thundering river of beasts tramples fields, fences and anyone in the way.
